input.rationale: Payment of ₹32,000 (3,200,000 paise) captured on 2026-09-02 for student Aadhya Deshpande matches invoice INV-00122 issued on the same date for customer Aadhya Deshpande (CUST00104) with identical amount. Customer identity confirmed via payment notes matching invoice customer name.
